Subject: Unexpected surcharge on May invoice (MKLY-INV-202705) & SLA credit request

Hi Naomi,

I've attached our May invoice (MKLY-INV-202705) and the latency export for the spike on May 12. We were charged an unexpected surcharge of $2,100 labeled as "burst overage" on the invoice total ($18,420). Our platform experienced higher-than-expected tail latency that day and a handful of timeouts; several jobs failed and required retries. Given the SLA language in our contract and the operational impact, we'd like Redwood to either issue a service credit for the surcharge amount or apply a goodwill credit while you investigate.

Can you confirm receipt of the attachments (MKLY-INV-202705.pdf, latency_logs_May12.csv) and advise next steps? We need the adjustment to be reflected in June's billing cycle if possible.

Thanks,

Hi Elena — thanks for sending the invoice and logs. I’ve looped in Ben (Billing) and Laura (Finance Ops) to review the charge and confirm the right path for an adjustment. A couple of quick notes and asks so we can move fast:

- We received the attached files and started a preliminary review of the May 12 window.
- To expedite a credit, could you confirm the list of API keys/prefixes affected (one-line list) and the Marketly internal PO or billing contact we should reference on the credit memo?
- We can provisionally apply a goodwill credit equal to 50% of the surcharge ($1,050) while we complete a formal audit; the remaining amount can be applied contingent on the audit findings. This gets you immediate relief in June billing.

Proposed next steps (suggested timeline):
1) Marketly confirm affected prefixes and PO by EOD Jun 4.
2) Redwood runs audit and posts a credit memo draft (Ben). Target Jun 4–6.
3) Finalize credit and ledger entry after audit; if findings support full credit, remainder is issued by Jun 10.

If that plan works, Ben will prepare the draft credit memo and I’ll track approvals. I’ll also add a short mutual action plan (MAP) link for signature so we can document the timeline and responsibilities.

Hi Elena / team — quick update from Billing after reviewing the attached logs and our telemetry. We verified increased queueing on the inference pool associated with Marketly on 2027-05-12; latency percentiles exceeded the SLA threshold for a 2-hour window. Per contract we are able to issue a service credit for measurable SLA lapses.

What we propose:
- Immediate goodwill credit: $1,050 applied to MKLY-INV-202705 (50% of surcharge) to be reflected as a negative line on your June statement. This is issued now to reduce operational impact.
- Contingent credit: up to $1,050 additional credit pending the audit of retries and customer-visible errors; if audit confirms systemic SLA breach per the contract definitions we will apply the remaining $1,050 by Jun 10.

I’ve attached a draft credit memo for your review (credit_memo_draft.pdf). Please confirm the PO/reference for the memo. Once Elena confirms, we’ll:
1) Post the immediate credit and issue the memo.
2) Run the follow-on audit (internal) and provide findings.
3) Finalize any additional adjustment.

If you prefer a single-step full reversal instead of the two-step approach, we can escalate to Finance leadership for an immediate full credit — but that will take longer to process (extra approvals).

Ben Carter
Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
